added.member: UI documents: drag and drop and Pointer Events
added.summary: draggable="true" with data-drag-type, and ondragstart, ondragend, ondragover and ondrop (drop targets filter by data-accept); onpointerdown, onpointermove, onpointerup and onwheel on any element. Events bubble to the nearest handler and carry { dragged, target } row keys and { x, y } in the handler's box (wheel: deltaX, deltaY).

added.member: UI documents: onhold, oncontextmenu, onrevealed, ontoggle, onclose
added.summary: Parsed as handlers; the controls that fire them land with the capabilities work (holdButton, menus, typewriter text, popovers, dialogs).
